notes: Category A sales (standard market-value transactions) of houses and flats, 2023-2026, within 2500 m of the site (postcode centroid). Sales in age-restricted retirement schemes carry retirement=true (25); 2 duplicate records (same address, date and price) removed. Floor areas not included: the EPC register's robots.txt disallows automated access and the bulk EPC download needs a GOV.UK One Login account; re-run with --epc-csv once the Bromley file is downloaded.
